dimension_evidence.diagnosis: Correct diagnosis must separate eager numerical semantics from source-generation syntax and recognize that an ordinary string conversion produces a token that is valid in Python but not a self-contained native floating-point expression. The same contract exists in two wrapper implementations.
dimension_evidence.localization: The Prompt narrows the failure to AOT packaging of a user-defined CUDA pointwise kernel but reveals no wrapper implementation, helper, literal, or file. Reproduction and inspection of generated native call arguments are still required to localize the two code-generation paths.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The repair must encode endpoint scalar values into valid generated code in both wrapper paths while preserving finite scalar emission. The oracle compares endpoint and finite cases with eager values, shape, dtype, and CUDA execution.
